decisions.reason: The margin analysis still has its own page in both years and extends the firm's data-driven platform direction, so the visible commitment and strategic fit justify persisting with it.

Although its web presence shrank from its own page to a mention, the regional electricity tariff calculator sits at the core of the firm's established tariff-calculation business, so management will likely attribute weaker visibility to temporary consolidation and keep it.

The area definition tool was downgraded to a mention, but it underpins the regional tariff and margin offerings and draws on the invested market-data infrastructure, so sunk costs and its platform role favor retaining it.
